## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: mixed sector returns (Energy/Utilities/Staples up, Financials/Industrials/Comm down) and leadership concentrated in Tech (Top 5: Tech 4/5) — narrow, tech-led strength with uneven participation.

2. Which sectors are leading?  
Energy leading: XOM (1W: +1.48% | 1M: -11.95%) in RECOVERY; Utilities leading: CEG (1W: +10.09% | 1M: +1.40%) ABOVE TREND; Consumer Staples leading: PM (1W: +8.25% | 1M: +1.44%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?  
Communication lagging: CHTR (1W: -28.45% | 1M: -21.00%) BELOW TREND; Consumer Discretionary lagging: BKNG (1W: -9.16% | 1M: +6.70%) in CORRECTION; Industrials lagging: LMT (1W: -10.43% | 1M: -16.81%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?  
Top 5: INTC (1W: +27.56% | 1M: +95.97%) ABOVE TREND, TXN (1W: +13.66% | 1M: +39.23%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +13.61% | 1M: +60.01%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +10.65% | 1M: +18.01%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +10.09% | 1M: +1.40%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (Tech 4/5).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?  
Bottom 5: DHR (1W: -8.00% | 1M: -1.40%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -8.40% | 1M: +19.25%) in CORRECTION, ACN (1W: -8.57% | 1M: -6.93%) BELOW TREND, IBM (1W: -8.85% | 1M: -1.40%) BELOW TREND, BKNG (1W: -9.16% | 1M: +6.70%) in CORRECTION.

6. Momentum Stocks?  
Strongest 1W movers: INTC (1W: +27.56% | 1M: +95.97%) ABOVE TREND, TXN (1W: +13.66% | 1M: +39.23%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +13.61% | 1M: +60.01%) ABOVE TREND. Note MAJOR divergence: several large caps (JPM, V, MA, TSLA) show 1W vs 1M mismatch (≥3 major names) — treat as a tactical divergence, watch for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?  
Technology mixed but strong breadth among semiconductors; AAPL (1W: +1.71% | 1M: +8.81%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +1.20% | 1M: +20.32%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +6.65% | 1M: +27.25%) ABOVE TREND while ORCL (1W: -8.40% | 1M: +19.25%) sits in CORRECTION and NOW (1W: -9.64% | 1M: -8.97%) BELOW TREND — Technology shows internal rotation.

8. Financials Outlook?  
Financials show mixed signals and soft 1W performance; JPM (1W: -0.50% | 1M: +10.68%) in CORRECTION, V (1W: -0.21% | 1M: +4.66%) in CORRECTION, MA (1W: -0.73% | 1M: +5.01%) in CORRECTION, while select banks show positive news — sector in internal rotation/weakness.

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
Healthcare uneven: UNH (1W: +6.00% | 1M: +41.60%) ABOVE TREND but DHR (1W: -8.00% | 1M: -1.40%) BELOW TREND and LLY (1W: -3.21% | 1M: -0.48%) BELOW TREND — sector showing fragmentation and headline-driven moves.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
Favor selective tech semiconductors and names showing genuine 1W+1M confirmation (INTC, AMD, NVDA) and selective cyclicals with confirmed momentum (UNP, NUE, BA); reduce exposure to names showing clear 1W weakness and negative trend (NOW, LMT, DHR). Style: Growth/momentum tilt but mixed breadth — be selective given narrow leadership and major-cap divergences.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +27.56% | 1M: +95.97%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +6.00% | 1M: +41.60%) ABOVE TREND, NUE (1W: +8.19% | 1M: +38.26%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: AMGN (news -85) watch for follow-through, NOW (1W: -9.64% | 1M: -8.97%) BELOW TREND, CHTR (1W: -28.45% | 1M: -21.00%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Real Estate (small positive) and Utilities (CEG strength) as potential safe havens; Energy to watch for earnings/price action. BEARISH: Communication and Consumer Discretionary where 1W weakness is concentrated (CHTR, BKNG).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
NVDA (1W: +6.65% | 1M: +27.25%) ABOVE TREND — watch for resistance near recent highs for continuation. AAPL (1W: +1.71% | 1M: +8.81%) ABOVE TREND — monitor pullback levels near recent support. INTC (1W: +27.56% | 1M: +95.97%) ABOVE TREND — momentum confirmation above this week’s close is a trigger for further rotation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?  
BA (+60): Panama order headline; BA (1W: +5.27% | 1M: +21.10%) ABOVE TREND — news confirmed by price. NUE (+50): Q1 beat; NUE (1W: +8.19% | 1M: +38.26%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. V (+50): strong earnings note; V (1W: -0.21% | 1M: +4.66%) in CORRECTION — sentiment positive but short-term price shows mild divergence.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?  
NOW (-60): weak Q1 reaction; NOW (1W: -9.64% | 1M: -8.97%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. LMT (-50): program concerns; LMT (1W: -10.43% | 1M: -16.81%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. PM (-55): forecast concerns; PM (1W: +8.25% | 1M: +1.44%) ABOVE TREND — notable divergence between negative news and rising price, monitor for distribution.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a growth/momentum tilt given narrow tech leadership and mixed sector participation. INTC (1W: +27.56% | 1M: +95.97%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +13.61% | 1M: +60.01%) ABOVE TREND and NVDA (1W: +6.65% | 1M: +27.25%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength. Key risk is major-cap divergence (JPM/V/MA/TSLA showing 1W weakness vs 1M strength) and headline-driven moves in Healthcare and Communication that could widen the internal split.
